name: fractal_breakout_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, 5-bar fractal swing highs — where one bar's high exceeds the 2 bars on each side over a 25-second window — represent micro price-discovery peaks where short-sellers and profit-takers cluster limit sell orders. When NIFTY's close breaks above a recent fractal high with all three Alligator SMAs (25s/40s/65s) in bullish alignment, it signals that resting supply at that swing level has been absorbed and fresh institutional momentum is sweeping the order book — stop-loss orders on short positions trigger a secondary push that typically extends 15-25 NIFTY spot points. We require 2 consecutive 5-second bars above the fractal level to eliminate single-tick noise disproportionately common in NIFTY's 5-second candles due to constituent rebalancing lag.
core_signal_oneliner: Two consecutive 5s closes above a recent 5-bar Williams Fractal high with all three Alligator SMAs in bullish alignment and price above VWAP
